title: Ghaf Tree-Crown Mapping from Area-Wide UAV Imagery
description:
Code, configurations and documentation for delineating Ghaf (Prosopis cineraria) tree crowns in area-wide UAV orthomosaics. Six semantic-segmentation models are trained and compared on one dataset, one augmentation pipeline, one schedule and one metric implementation; the proposed model pairs a FastViT-MA36 backbone with a Mask2Former decode head and reaches 79.32 mIoU and 87.22 F1 on the held-out test split.

The repository is an overlay on stock mmsegmentation: it adds a two-class tile dataset, two backbones, six configurations, and an area-wide inference pipeline that maps a complete orthomosaic in overlapping Gaussian-blended windows and writes georeferenced probability, mask and crown-polygon outputs.

What this archive does not contain. The trained weights, the UAV imagery and the labelled tiles are not distributed with the code; they are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. ghaf/release.py records every released checkpoint's SHA-256, byte size, parameter count and test scores, so a copy obtained by any route can be verified against what was published.

Accompanies the manuscript "Hybrid Vision-CNN Architecture for Mapping Prosopis cineraria from Area-wide UAV-based Images".
notes: The trained weights, the UAV imagery and the labelled tiles are not included in this archive. Every value quoted in the documentation is traceable to docs/handover/FACTS.yml, which records the provenance of each figure and marks the values that were never established.
